info.name: RfourL PDSS - Integration Tests (IT-01 to IT-18)
info.description: Run with the Collection Runner or Newman, top to bottom, against a TEST database. Fill the collection variables first. DB side-effects must be verified in phpMyAdmin (noted per folder).

exec: // CI4 cookie-based CSRF: fetch a page, read the hidden token, send it with every request.
if (err) { console.log('CSRF probe failed', err); return; }

item.name: IT-01 Login + RBAC + Dashboard
item.description: Each role lands on its own dashboard; a role cannot open another role's page.

item.name: IT-02 Point of Sale + Inventory
item.description: Sell itemA x1 and itemB x2. THEN verify in phpMyAdmin: 1 sales_transaction, 2 sales_item rows, stock -1 / -2, inventory_log type SALE.

item.name: IT-03 POS + Reorder Alerts + Notifications
item.description: Sell {{itemIdRop}} down to its ROP, then open Reorder Alerts. The alert is raised when the Reorder Alerts page loads (ReorderAlertModel::syncFromLiveInventory) and uses products.manual_rop_warning, NOT the engine ROP, so set that field on the item first (see ST_AUDIT.md, ST-07). The code pushes no notification when the alert is raised.

item.name: 2. Reorder alerts list shows the item
IT-04 / IT-05 K-Means + Engine (run from terminal)
item.description: Not an HTTP flow. IT-04: `php spark dss:run` then check cluster_segments / products.abc_category. IT-05: stop the Flask service, run `php spark dss:run` again; expect 'Falling back to the last cached cluster assignment'. Health probe below.

item.name: IT-06 Settings (DSS parameter) + Engine
item.description: Change ordering cost to 300; verify dss_parameters.ordering_cost and updated_by, then run `php spark dss:run` and compare EOQ.

exec: pm.test('page does not contain "parameters updated"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("parameters updated")));

item.name: IT-07 Reorder Alert + Orders + Supplier Portal
item.description: Admin creates two orders for supplier {{supplierId}} (ids captured into orderId / orderId2); the supplier must then see them. Verify in DB: reorder_alert becomes Ordered when alert_id is sent.

exec: pm.test('page contains "created and sent to supplier"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("created and sent to supplier")));

const all = [...pm.response.text().matchAll(/Stock order (SO-\d+) created/g)]; if (all.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', all[all.length - 1][1]); } pm.test('captured orderId', () => pm.expect(all.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('page contains "created and sent to supplier"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("created and sent to supplier")));

const all = [...pm.response.text().matchAll(/Stock order (SO-\d+) created/g)]; if (all.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId2', all[all.length - 1][1]); } pm.test('captured orderId2', () => pm.expect(all.length).to.be.above(0));

item.name: Supplier sees order 1 in New Orders
Supplier sees order 2 in New Orders
IT-08 Supplier accept / decline + Notifications
item.description: Uses {{orderId}} (accept) and {{orderId2}} (decline). The code stores no decline reason (see ST_AUDIT.md, ST-09).

exec: pm.test('page contains "declined by supplier"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("declined by supplier")));

item.name: IT-09 Supplier ships order with tracking number
Admin order page shows Shipped + tracking
IT-10 Admin marks delivered -> inventory + alert
item.description: Verify afterwards: stock +48, inventory_log RESTOCK linked to the order, actual_delivery_date set, alert Fulfilled.

exec: pm.test('page contains "marked as Delivered"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("marked as Delivered")));

item.name: Again: stock must NOT be added twice (verify in DB)
IT-11 Staff restock for an already-received order
item.description: {{orderId}} is already Delivered, so Staff confirmation must be refused.

exec: pm.test('page contains "not ready to confirm"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("not ready to confirm")));

item.name: IT-12 Log damaged item
item.description: Verify afterwards: stock -1, inventory_log DAMAGED_LOST with the staff user_id, Admin notification.

item.name: Boundary: more damaged than on hand (document expects rejection)

exec: pm.test('page does not contain "logged successfully"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("logged successfully")));

item.name: IT-13 Log customer return with sale reference
item.description: Verify stock increases by the returned quantity. The code does not validate original_sale_ref (see ST_AUDIT.md, UT-33).

exec: pm.test('page does not contain "logged successfully"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("logged successfully")));

item.name: IT-14 Staff reset request + Admin approval
item.description: Staff submits a request; Admin finds it under notifications and approves. Verify the password result in DB / by logging in.

exec: const all = [...pm.response.text().matchAll(/notifications\/approve\/(\d+)/g)]; if (all.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationId', all[all.length - 1][1]); } pm.test('captured notificationId', () => pm.expect(all.length).to.be.above(0));

item.name: IT-15 Add supplier with portal account
item.description: Then log in with the new credentials.

exec: pm.test('page does not contain "Supplier added"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.variables.replaceIn("Supplier added")));

item.name: IT-16 Deactivate staff account
item.description: Deactivate staff user {{staffUserId}}, confirm the account cannot log in, then re-activate it so later runs still work.

exec: pm.test('not sent to the staff dashboard', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location') || '').to.not.include('/staff/dashboard'));

item.name: IT-17 / IT-18 Exports
item.description: Sales CSV for one day and one month, Sales PDF, and the Trend Analysis page. Row counts must be compared with the database (see SQL in docs/testing).

exec: pm.test('has header and data rows', () => { const lines = pm.response.text().trim().split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map(l => l.trim()); pm.expect(lines[0]).to.include('Receipt No'); pm.expect(lines.length).to.be.above(1); pm.collectionVariables.set('csvRows', String(lines.length - 1)); });

item.name: ST-13 / ST-15 Security probes
item.description: SQL injection on login, and a POST without a CSRF token.

item.name: SQLi in login form is rejected
POST without CSRF token is rejected

exec: // strip the CSRF cookie so no token can match
pm.test('rejected (403 or back to login)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code === 403 || (pm.response.headers.get('Location')||'').indexOf('/dashboard') === -1).to.be.true);
